text:
maria_dev: uploaded conversion candidate for artemis-13b to staging: s3://redwood-weights/onboard/artemis-13b/v1/artemis-13b-safetensors/

kevin_ml: nice — is this TP=4 as discussed? any nonstandard sharding (interleaved heads etc)?

maria_dev: yep TP=4. We shard across head dim with contiguous head slices per shard. Files named artemis-13b-00001.safetensors ... -00004.safetensors and each has accompanying .sha256.

leo_packager: quick checklist before I start packing:
- model_config.json included? needs fields: "tp_size":4, "dtype":"fp16", "kv_cache":true
- tokenizer files intact (tokenizer.json, merges, vocab)
- manifest/commit hash present

maria_dev: model_config.json is there. Tokenizer quirk: tokenizer.json sets "bos_token": "<s>" but the training pipeline used BOS id 2 (not the same). I added tokenizer-compat.json explaining mapping and a loader note.

tara_pm: will that require changes to the serving loader? I can update onboarding steps if so.

kevin_ml: serving runtime expects explicit special token ids on load. If the tokenizer's special token strings map to different ids we see prompt truncation. maria, can you add a small loader shim that enforces the expected ids at init? e.g.

```python
# loader shim
t = Tokenizer.from_file(path)
# ensure BOS maps to id 2 used in training
if t.convert_tokens_to_ids(t.bos_token) != 2:
    t.add_special_tokens({'bos_token': '<s>'})
    t._rebuild_special_mappings()
```

maria_dev: will add shim + unit test. Also found one shard with final layernorm saved as bfloat16 — conversion will coerce all tensors to fp16 with --force-dtype fp16. I'll enforce dtype parity across shards.

ci-bot: conversion-lint started for artemis-13b v1

ci-bot: conversion-lint: shard count OK (4), safetensors headers valid, model_config schema PASS, tokenizer:token-id-mismatch WARN (compat file present)

aj_sre: ops note: if we enable prefix KV caching on Dedicated, KV tensors must be laid out so slices align across TP axis. Are kv tensors sharded along head axis?

maria_dev: yes, kv layout is [layer][head][kv_dim] and we shard by head so contiguous slices line up for prefix caching. validated with small tool.

leo_packager: posted conversion PR: https://git.internal/redwood/meridian/convert/pull/87 
(contains convert script updates, dtype coercion, loader shim, and manifest generation)

kevin_ml: reviewing. I'll focus on the TP pack/unpack kernels and dtype coercion path. Also watch for safetensors tags of bfloat16 that slip through.

tara_pm: timeline check — can we aim for serve-ready signoff by next Tues EOD? I'll reserve an hour for a cross-team review on Tues.

maria_dev: timeline OK. Plan: push shim + tests today, merge PR tomorrow, run smoke serve in staging with 10 warmup requests.

ci-bot: smoke-serve-run: started (staging), run id: smoke-2146017890-1

maria_dev: smoke run finished: p95 latency=210ms, tokens/sec ~280 (staging g4dn), eval pass rate 100/100 on our small correctness set. No runtime errors.

kevin_ml: great. After merge, rollout policy suggestion: canary 3% -> 15% -> 60% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error rate >0.7% or latency spike >2x baseline. Fallback model: nova13b.

leo_packager: final artifacts: added manifest.json in shard dir with sha256 for each shard and convert_commit. Draft manifest snippet:

```json
{
  "shards": [
    {"name": "artemis-13b-00001.safetensors", "sha256": "f1e2d3..."},
    {"name": "artemis-13b-00002.safetensors", "sha256": "a4b5c6..."},
    {"name": "artemis-13b-00003.safetensors", "sha256": "d7e8f9..."},
    {"name": "artemis-13b-00004.safetensors", "sha256": "0a1b2c..."}
  ],
  "convert_commit": "b7c8d9e",
  "packager": "leo_packager"
}
```

aj_sre: I'll update Dedicated autoscaler and batch targets for batch_size=8 and target GPU util=88%.

tara_pm: thanks all — I'll mark onboarding doc "awaiting merge" and loop support for release notes and API docs.

kevin_ml: one more reviewer note: make sure the safetensors loader path has a fast coercion branch (no deep copies) when converting bfloat16->fp16 to avoid OOM during load.

maria_dev: noted. final steps: push PR, tag @kevin_ml for CR, merge, and trigger rollout. Will close thread after merge :thumbsup:
